newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip on long liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Tuesday due mainly to long liquidation in sluggish trade, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen to 1.4 yen per kg lower. Benchmark September was off 1.2 yen at 140.8 yen per kg.

"Sentiment remained bearish," one analyst at a commodity broker said. "Expectations that Japan's rubber stocks would rise further, combined with easier overseas prices, made investors wary of fresh buying," he said. Open interest in rubber futures has been on a downward trend in recent months, due to thin buying interest, traders said.
